subject.title: [Feature]: Improve Workspace Skill Loading: Add Frontmatter Parsing Error Visibility and Validation for SKILL.md

question: Should malformed workspace skill diagnostics be accepted as a new `skills lint` command first, or must normal `skills list`, gateway `skills.status`, and Web UI surfaces also report skipped candidates before this issue is considered fixed?
rationale: The code gap is clear, but completing the issue depends on maintainer intent about the user-visible diagnostic surface and how much path/parser detail should be exposed.

options.title: Require normal status/list/UI diagnostics
options.body: Treat `skills lint` as useful but insufficient until skipped-candidate diagnostics are visible in the surfaces users already check when a skill disappears.

options.title: Accept lint as the first fix
options.body: Allow the open PR to close the issue once lint correctness is fixed, and track list/status/Web visibility as follow-up work.

options.title: Pause for a narrower design
options.body: Hold the PR until maintainers define a smaller redaction-safe diagnostic contract for malformed local skill files.

recommendation.title: Require normal status/list/UI diagnostics
recommendation.body: Treat `skills lint` as useful but insufficient until skipped-candidate diagnostics are visible in the surfaces users already check when a skill disappears.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent work spans the loader/status/CLI surfaces where the product scope choice would land.
